reply_text: @Gideon Sato: you first reported the kiosks offline at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug, in your first message in this channel. The channel shows the guard writing trailer numbers on a clipboard at that point. The next entry is Mateo at 11:03 AM, saying kiosk 1 was back and the guard had checked in trailer 8836. Your 11:08 AM update says both lanes were working as of 11:07. The channel doesn't record anything else the guard did between 10:42 and 11:03, so for a fuller picture you'd need to ask the site.
